name: Cauldron Dance — each "That creature gains haste" is its own pick
notes: Sweep singleton (2026-10-07). "Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield. That creature gains haste. …" and, on the next line, "You may put a creature card from your hand onto the battlefield. That creature gains haste. …" gave one haste effect: the keyword-grant parser dropped the second identical grant, and both sentences were pronouns for one target. A spell's identical grants on different lines are now kept apart, and "That creature gains/gets/has …" right after a sentence that puts a creature card onto the battlefield reads "Target creature …" (_resolveItPronoun), so each line is a target slot. Bears (slot 0) and Ogre (slot 1) have haste; Hill Giant does not.
